sql:
SELECT first_name, district
FROM (
  SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, DOC AS district FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AdmFName2 AS first_name, DOC AS district FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AdmFName3 AS first_name, DOC AS district FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY first_name, district
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 2;
